thread:
sasha: noticed weird focus behavior in model catalog compare when pinning versions. keyboard users lose focus. tagging @tom for eng, @kim for design.

tom: can you repro steps?

sasha: open catalog -> select two models -> Compare -> press Pin on row. focus jumps to top of page and tab order breaks.

anya: likely we reparent the row into a pinned group. reparenting removes activeElement.

kim: design stance: prefer DOM stability. we can visually group with CSS (sticky/transform) instead of moving nodes.

Tom: agree. engineering options: (1) keep DOM + clone inert visual anchor, (2) move node but restore focus and announce. clone needs aria-hidden + tabindex=-1.

a11y-bot: moving interactive elements confuses screen readers. recommend stable DOM and a single polite live region update: "Pinned: v2.3".

sasha: also perf badge tooltip gets clipped when pinned. mount tooltips to body or set overflow visible.

kim: microcopy change: button text -> "Pin"; tooltip -> "Pin — keep this version visible in comparisons". short, clear.

tom: i'll prototype sticky + aria-live and open a PR for QA. @sasha please verify keyboard SR flow after.
